page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-hypervised server provides 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.r7.8xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory tasks. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 30,983.52 and a PassMark CPU score of 35,326.14. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large block bandwidth of 141.73 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 65.94 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in small-model LLM text generation, reaching 282.15 tokens/sec with a 135M model, while maintaining average speeds of 17.54 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage. The absence of bundled local SSDs means storage costs are decoupled, which is advantageous for memory-bound applications that persist data externally. The ecs.r7.8xlarge is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and moderate-scale data processing tasks.
